subject: Monza striker Gustavo Varela leads Serie A scoring and has Europe calling
title: Monza's man, Europe's wish list

lines.vo: Two and a half million, reportedly. Now he tops Serie A.
Gustavo Varela is twenty-one and tops the scoring chart. Monza are still in the relegation zone. Somebody tell the other ten.
Nine league goals, eleven in all competitions, with a Coppa Italia brace. Eleven goals in eleven games. Easy maths.
lines.footage: Monza Avellino Coppa Italia Varela brace

lines.vo: His first senior Portugal call-up came this November. Funny how scoring every game gets you noticed.
Tottenham have made an enquiry. Liverpool are watching every week. Juventus and Napoli want a January deal.
Goal says Monza want thirty-five million euros. That is fourteen times what they reportedly paid Benfica. No bank offers that rate.
